verdicts.reason: A copies the landscape block unchanged: the 3-line headline runs almost edge to edge (~50px side margins) while large empty orange bands sit above and below, so it reads as a shrunk banner rather than a portrait layout. B rewraps the headline to 4 lines at a larger size that uses the portrait height and keeps the CTA clearly second, but the group sits low: the CTA is close to the bottom edge, with a much bigger empty area above the headline than below the button.
